topic: Revival of banked downgraded parent stat_dp_cate_minimax_v1_holder_central_dp. Determine the incremental central-private minimax price for pointwise CATE on the exact-uniform coupled-nuisance Holder class with q=alpha+beta<gamma, leaving the separate nonprivate risk R_n^NP symbolic. Prove R_n^DP equivalent to max{R_n^NP,rho_n^priv} with an explicit phase diagram, one total private higher-order local estimator with complete all-dataset sensitivity accounting, and a matching positive-design fuzzy causal converse beyond the parent's two-point-TV barrier. Independently verify the presolved candidate rho_n^priv=max{(n epsilon_n)^(-gamma/(gamma+d)),(n^2 epsilon_n)^(-1/(1+d/gamma+d/q))}; do not restore the parent's unsupported (n epsilon)^(-q/(q+d)) formula. Do not duplicate or assume queued stat_cate_uniform_sparse_component_converse, which concerns only R_n^NP. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: A fixed-uniform-design projection identity makes local R-moment bias the product of alpha- and beta-projection errors plus gamma-localization bias. Binomial-normalized within-cell pair averages have exact expectation and claimed replacement sensitivity C/(n^2 h^d ell^d), avoiding nuisance pilots and occupancy logarithms. A same-class smooth fuzzy family has singleton cancellation; component maximal couplings and a spanning-tree sum claim Hamming cost C ab n^2 h^d ell^d, leading with adjacent-output DP telescoping to rho_priv=max{(n epsilon)^(-gamma/(gamma+d)),(n^2 epsilon)^(-1/(1+d/gamma+d/(alpha+beta)))}. The d=1, alpha=beta=1/8, gamma=1, epsilon=n^(-2/5) specialization gives matching n^(-4/15) upper and lower scales. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Below the nuisance elbow when privacy is inactive, replace the known nonprivate upper benchmark by symbolic R_n^NP using an independently verified comparator or a new privacy-transfer lemma; the queued nonprivate result is not assumed. EARLY KILL TEST: Verify the complete d=1 pair-release sensitivity and component-Hamming calculation at h proportional to n^(-4/15), ell proportional to n^(-16/15); stop on a surviving singleton, false factorization, or normalization bias. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/stat_dp_cate_uniform_design_nuisance_privacy_frontier.md.

open_problems.open_problem: Determine whether a total binomial-normalized within-cell pair estimator can simultaneously retain the exact-uniform nuisance-product projection identity and achieve replacement sensitivity C/(n^2 h^d ell^d) on every dataset without occupancy conditioning or unprotected nuisance pilots.

source_refs.claim: Black-box privatization of U-statistics can be suboptimal; exploiting degeneracy requires thresholded local Hajek projections.
source_refs.author: Kamalika Chaudhuri, Po-Ling Loh, Shourya Pandey, Purnamrita Sarkar

source_refs.claim: Its nonprivate pointwise-CATE estimator uses a localized pair correction whose bias contains a product of nuisance approximation errors.
source_refs.author: Edward H. Kennedy, Sivaraman Balakrishnan, James M. Robins, Larry Wasserman

source_refs.excerpt: Exactly 2(m-1) ordered pairs ... can change in the quadratic average.
Add a compact derivation table linking each private pilot, moment block, and Gaussian release to its sensitivity contrib

open_problems.why_unsolved: A literal bounded all-pairs statistic divided by binom(n,2) changes in as many as n-1 summands when one record is replaced, giving generic global sensitivity of order 1/(n h^d ell^d), not 1/(n^2 h^d ell^d). Random cell denominators introduce additional empty-cell, singleton, and normalization effects, while typical sparse occupancy cannot establish pure DP's all-dataset guarantee. The banked construction controls a larger ordered-pair sensitivity, and Chaudhuri et al. show that improved private behavior for degenerate U-statistics needs specialized projection-aware stabilization. Thus the presolved sensitivity claim fails for the literal all-pairs release unless an additional deterministic cap, cancellation, thresholding, or reweighting device is supplied. In the requested d=1 specialization, h proportional to n^(-4/15) and ell proportional to n^(-16/15) make the candidate n^(-2) balance algebraically equal n^(-4/15), but the generic n^(-1) replacement bound is larger by a factor n and destroys that calculation.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: An explicitly normalized pure-DP statistic with an exact expectation identity, a record-by-record all-dataset sensitivity proof of order C/(n^2 h^d ell^d), and risk h^gamma+ell^q+1/(n^2 epsilon h^d ell^d), or a neighboring-dataset counterexample proving this sensitivity order unattainable for the proposed pair release.

writing_exemplar.why: Its formulation isolates the same tension between naive U-statistic sensitivity and projection structure capable of improving private error.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: higher-order CATE corrections are pair statistics -> naive neighboring-dataset analysis loses degeneracy -> projection-aware stabilization may recover a smaller private cost -> determine whether exact-uniform CATE corrections admit such an all-dataset construction

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt thresholding and reweighting based on local Hajek projections together with the proof of a valid private sensitivity envelope.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired correction is a localized degree-two statistic whose claimed n^(-2) privacy behavior must come from structure beyond ordinary all-pairs normalization.

method_exemplars.technique: Retain the localized higher-order projection correction and redo its exact expectation, bias, and variance after the privacy stabilization.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It provides the nonprivate pair correction and product-bias identity that the modified release must preserve.

method_exemplars.technique: Construct a smooth upper envelope for local sensitivity and prove neighboring-dataset smoothness if deterministic clipping cannot attain the target.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The obstruction is the gap between typical sparse occupancy and the worst-case sensitivity required by differential privacy.

open_problems.open_problem: Construct or rule out a smooth exact-uniform positive-design fuzzy CATE family with singleton-mixture cancellation and a joint component coupling of expected Hamming cost C a b n^2 h^d ell^d, sufficient for the proposed nuisance-sensitive central-private converse.

source_refs.claim: The nonprivate CATE lower bound uses localized fuzzy hypotheses combining nonparametric-regression and nonlinear-functional constructions.
source_refs.author: Edward H. Kennedy, Sivaraman Balakrishnan, James M. Robins, Larry Wasserman

source_refs.claim: Central-DP Le Cam, Fano, and Assouad bounds can be expressed through expected Hamming distance under couplings of composite sample laws.
source_refs.author: Jayadev Acharya, Ziteng Sun, Huanyu Zhang

source_refs.claim: Private testing lower bounds can be formulated as transport problems whose strength depends on the available hypothesis-class coupling.
source_refs.author: Clément Lalanne, Aurélien Garivier, Rémi Gribonval

source_refs.excerpt: The conclusion concerns that proof method only; it is not an impossibility theorem for fuzzy mixtures
the construction's CATE perturbation violated gamma-Holder smoothness when q<gamma
one-observation cancellation alone does not control a shared-prior product likelihood.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The parent proves only that ordinary two-point arguments controlled through n times total variation cannot recover the nuisance-sensitive private branch. Kennedy et al.'s fuzzy mixtures control nonprivate testing affinity, whereas private testing requires an explicit low-Hamming coupling or transport bound between the induced sample mixtures. The previous positive-microcell witness is unusable because its q-scale target perturbation violates gamma-Hölder smoothness. Moreover, singleton cancellation does not by itself control a shared-prior product mixture, and separately valid edgewise maximal couplings or a spanning-tree sum do not automatically produce one joint coupling with the asserted Hamming expectation. The queued sparse-component project addresses a different, nonprivate Hellinger converse and is not assumed here.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: Two finite priors supported on the same exact-uniform positive gamma-Hölder causal class, with target separation of order (n^2 epsilon_n)^(-1/(1+d/gamma+d/q)), exact singleton-mixture equality, and a rigorously constructed joint coupling satisfying E[d_H] at most C a b n^2 h^d ell^d, or a counterexample locating the failure of singleton cancellation or spanning-tree composition.

writing_exemplar.why: Its regression-functional hybrid narrative and localized fuzzy construction provide the natural setup, with privacy transport introduced as the new missing ingredient.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: pointwise CATE combines localization with a nonlinear nuisance product -> low nuisance smoothness creates a fuzzy-hypothesis elbow -> privacy restricts distinguishability through record adjacency -> construct or rule out a legal fuzzy family with low-Hamming transport

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt its localized fuzzy nuisance perturbations and first-order cancellation while replacing the original design geometry by smooth exact-uniform positive components.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The lower bound must remain inside the identical causal Hölder class and reproduce its regression-functional separation geometry.

method_exemplars.technique: Feed a proved coupling of the composite sample laws into the central-DP Le Cam or Assouad inequality.
method_exemplars.why_closest: This is the direct mechanism converting the proposed Hamming calculation into a privacy-specific minimax lower bound.

method_exemplars.technique: Formulate the mixture-coupling step as an optimal-transport problem and prove the global cost before applying privacy contraction.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Its framework directly tests whether local component couplings genuinely assemble into the joint transport object required by the resolution.

open_problems.open_problem: Determine whether the incremental pure-central-DP pointwise-CATE minimax price on the exact-uniform coupled-nuisance Hölder class is max{(n epsilon_n)^(-gamma/(gamma+d)),(n^2 epsilon_n)^(-1/(1+d/gamma+d/q))} for q=alpha+beta<gamma, while keeping the separate nonprivate risk symbolic.

source_refs.claim: Derives a nonprivate pointwise-CATE minimax rate and nuisance-smoothness elbow using higher-order local estimation and fuzzy hypotheses.
source_refs.author: Edward H. Kennedy, Sivaraman Balakrishnan, James M. Robins, Larry Wasserman

source_refs.excerpt: The full beta<gamma frontier ... remains open.
no proved coupling or stabilized higher-order full-class release decides whether gamma, q, or private-Gram costs are nec

open_problems.why_unsolved: The literature covers three separate corners: the nonprivate coupled-nuisance CATE problem, practical private CATE learners without minimax guarantees, and private pointwise estimation for an ordinary regression function. The parent establishes only a gamma-smooth private-regression lower branch and a beta-smooth direct-regression upper branch; its earlier (n epsilon_n)^(-q/(q+d)) expression was neither proved attainable nor necessary. The proposed two terms follow formal bias-noise balances, but the second balance presupposes the unverified n^(-2) sensitivity and fuzzy-mixture Hamming calculations isolated above. Therefore the candidate frontier cannot be treated as presolved, even though its exponent algebra and the d=1 specialization are internally consistent conditional on those lemmas.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A same-class theorem proving R_n^DP asymptotically equivalent to max{R_n^NP,(n epsilon_n)^(-gamma/(gamma+d)),(n^2 epsilon_n)^(-1/(1+d/gamma+d/q))}, with explicit phase inequalities and the d=1, alpha=beta=1/8, gamma=1, epsilon_n=n^(-2/5) specialization reducing to n^(-4/15), or a theorem replacing the failed candidate branch by the correct privacy modulus.

writing_exemplar.why: It directly motivates privacy for heterogeneous causal effects; the new work can turn its empirical utility question into a sharp minimax phase problem.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: CATE estimation uses sensitive individual records -> privacy perturbs multistage heterogeneous-effect learning -> existing methods lack a sharp statistical utility benchmark -> characterize the incremental private minimax price on the exact-uniform Hölder model

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt the localized higher-order R-learner, its product-of-projection-errors decomposition, and its fuzzy-hypothesis benchmark.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It treats the same pointwise CATE regression-functional hybrid and supplies the nonprivate architecture over which the incremental privacy price must be layered.

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt its pointwise private bias-noise balance and organization of matching private lower bounds.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Its one-function problem generates the direct localization privacy barrier, while CATE adds a second nuisance-product scale.

method_exemplars.technique: Use the central-DP testing reduction from expected-Hamming couplings of composite hypotheses.
method_exemplars.why_closest: A sharp second privacy term requires converting the causal fuzzy mixture into exactly the coupling quantity controlled by this theorem.

open_problems.open_problem: Identify a stability condition under which a nonprivate pointwise-CATE benchmark with risk R_n^NP can be converted into one pure-central-DP estimator with risk bounded by max{R_n^NP,rho_n^priv}, without assuming the queued exact-uniform nonprivate converse.

source_refs.author: Edward H. Kennedy

source_refs.claim: Uses sample splitting and composition for private multistage CATE learners but does not prove a black-box minimax-risk transfer theorem.

source_refs.excerpt: Below that elbow, claim only the proved bracket and leave the exact-uniform nuisance converse open.
The novelty-bearing claim is the full-support fixed-n lower bound.
the privacy-free full-positive-density limit ... remains open.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The lower comparison R_n^DP at least R_n^NP is immediate, but a risk guarantee alone gives no neighboring-dataset stability, so arbitrary output perturbation cannot provide the desired symbolic upper comparison. Existing private CATE methods control selected component learners, while private pointwise-regression results are estimator-specific. The banked exact-uniform work supplies upper constructions only on part of the phase diagram, and the queued sparse-component result concerns the separate nonprivate converse and remains unproved. The missing first step is therefore a concrete stability interface—such as a bounded score representation, clipping certificate, or robust oracle inequality—not another assertion that generic privatization preserves minimax risk.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A privacy-transfer lemma for an explicit stability modulus of pointwise-CATE estimators, together with a construction verifying that modulus and proving risk at most C max{R_n^NP,rho_n^priv}, or a pair of equally accurate nonprivate procedures showing that no transfer theorem based only on R_n^NP can hold.

writing_exemplar.why: Its oracle-inequality organization treats the second-stage CATE learner modularly and is a natural template for retaining a symbolic nonprivate comparator.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: CATE estimation uses estimated pseudo-outcomes -> an oracle inequality separates regression and nuisance errors -> privacy adds a distinct neighboring-dataset stability constraint -> characterize the interface that preserves a symbolic nonprivate benchmark

method_exemplars.technique: Use its pseudo-outcome oracle decomposition to isolate the score or final regression functional whose bounded differences must be established.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Its bound already keeps the oracle regression term abstract, matching the desired symbolic R_n^NP comparison.

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt sample splitting and privacy composition across nuisance estimation and the final CATE release.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It is the closest existing modular privacy architecture for multistage CATE learning, though a new stability theorem is needed for minimax risk.

method_exemplars.technique: Replace unavailable global stability by a smooth upper bound on local sensitivity and prove its noise is dominated by rho_n^priv.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It addresses the logical gap between typical statistical stability and the all-neighbor guarantee required for pure DP.

literature_map:
Kennedy, Balakrishnan, Robins, and Wasserman (Annals of Statistics 2024; arXiv:2203.00837) give the closest nonprivate pointwise-CATE minimax benchmark and higher-order construction.
Their nuisance elbow comes from a localized regression-functional hybrid and fuzzy hypotheses, not from privacy analysis.
Kennedy (Electronic Journal of Statistics 2023; arXiv:2004.14497) supplies modular pseudo-outcome oracle inequalities useful for a symbolic comparator.
Niu et al. (CLeaR 2022; arXiv:2202.11043) privatize practical CATE meta-learners but provide no Hölder minimax frontier.
Cai, Chakraborty, and Vuursteen (2024; arXiv:2406.06755) establish private pointwise nonparametric-regression rates but not coupled causal nuisances.
Acharya, Sun, and Zhang (ALT 2021; arXiv:2004.06830) provide DP Le Cam and Assouad reductions based on expected-Hamming couplings.
Lalanne, Garivier, and Gribonval (TMLR 2023LIKELY; arXiv:2210.02215) emphasize the transport object required by private composite testing.
Chaudhuri, Loh, Pandey, and Sarkar (NeurIPS 2024; arXiv:2407.04945) show that useful private U-statistic rates require projection-aware stabilization.
Nissim, Raskhodnikova, and Smith (STOC 2007; DOI:10.1145/1250790.1250803) explain why typical local sensitivity cannot directly calibrate private noise.
The proposed first branch follows the familiar pointwise balance h^gamma=1/(n epsilon h^d).
The proposed second branch follows h^gamma=ell^q=1/(n^2 epsilon h^d ell^d), but only if the n^(-2) sensitivity or matching Hamming transport exists.
A literal all-pairs release has sensitivity order 1/(n h^d ell^d), because replacing one record changes n-1 pairs.
For d=1, alpha=beta=1/8, gamma=1, and epsilon=n^(-2/5), the conditional second balance gives h=n^(-4/15), ell=n^(-16/15), and error n^(-4/15).
No scanned paper establishes both the total private higher-order CATE estimator and the positive exact-uniform fuzzy coupling needed for that scale.
